summary_en: The video captures a meaningful community initiative in Phu Quoc, Kien Giang, where residents gather to prepare ingredients, wrap, and cook thousands of cylindrical glutinous rice cakes over wood fires day and night to support people in Northern Vietnam, followed by vacuum sealing and loading them onto delivery trucks.
